# EnigmaCoder

> EnigmaCoder is an AI-native engineering IDE that unites project context, code editing, terminal execution, and multi-agent coordination in a single desktop environment for Windows.

EnigmaCoder enables developers to move from idea to working software using a PLAN → CODE → RUN → DEBUG → VERIFY pipeline driven by AI engineering agents.

## Product

- [EnigmaCoder IDE](https://www.enigmacoder.dev/product): Full AI-native engineering environment for Windows. Includes Monaco code editor, integrated terminal, browser runtime, agent canvas, and AI chat.
- [Download](https://www.enigmacoder.dev/download): Download EnigmaCoder IDE v1.20.0 for Windows (x64).
- [EnigmaCoder 2B Model](https://huggingface.co/enigmacoder/EnigmaCoder-2B): Our first open model trained for agentic software engineering tasks.

## AI Agents

- [Agent Directory](https://www.enigmacoder.dev/agents): 124 specialist agents across 11 engineering departments including Frontend, Backend, DevOps, Security, Data, QA, and more.

## Models

- [Models](https://www.enigmacoder.dev/models): EnigmaCoder 2B and supported model integrations.
